axes.name: local_declaration_order
axes.rationale: Target body saves DI and SI, then uses DI as the redraw-loop index and SI as the Dx8 pointer. The prior named-buffer candidate instead spills the pointer to [bp-2] and uses SI as the index. Only equivalent declaration ordering of initialized locals hs, p, i, and v changes; expressions and control flow are fixed.

semantic_summary: Isolated bounded local declaration-order probe from the best named H-buffer source; test whether MSC7 local allocation order selects the target DI-index/SI-pointer loop schedule.
binding_evidence: Target aligned assembly saves DI and SI, uses DI as index and SI as pointer in the redraw loop. Prior candidate uses a frame spill for p and allocates SI/CX/BX differently. Source locals hs,p,i,v are all assigned before read.
